Chuck Person’s Eccojams Vol. 1 cassette

Daniel Lopatin’s 2010 cassette of slowed loops, packaged to look like the box of the 1993 game Ecco the Dolphin.

Source
Wikipedia: Chuck Person’s Eccojams Vol. 1
Creator
Chuck Person (Daniel Lopatin)
Made

Style
Vaporwave (precursor; agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Released in August 2010 on cassette by The Curatorial Club. Wikipedia: “With packaging that resembled the 1993 video game Ecco the Dolphin, the album inspired a host of suburban teens and young adults to formulate what would become vaporwave.” Wikipedia: Vaporwave.

Lopatin had released several of the loops earlier on YouTube as sunsetcorp, from his audio-visual album Memory Vague (2009). Wikipedia: Vaporwave.

Why it belongs

The packaging is appropriation of a specific commercial object, not a new graphic language. That act of quoting a mass-market product is what the style kept.
